nature_language_en: [Current location: Hangzhou, Destination: Beijing, Number of travelers: 3, Number of travel days: 4] The three of us plan to take either a high-speed train (G) or a bullet train (D) to Beijing for a four-day trip. Our budget is quite sufficient, and we aim to see as many historical and revolutionary sites as possible. Other attractions are not a priority.
